# True North Roofing

> Roofing contractor serving Asheville and Western North Carolina. Roof replacement,
> roof repair, standing seam metal roofing, seamless gutters and free photo-documented
> roof inspections. Tagline: "Where craftsmanship meets conviction."

Phone: (828) 507-0778
Location: Asheville, NC 28803
Service area: Buncombe, Henderson, Haywood, Transylvania, Madison, Jackson and McDowell
counties — including Asheville, Hendersonville, Waynesville, Brevard, Black Mountain,
Weaverville, Arden, Fletcher, Candler, Fairview, Maggie Valley, Canton, Mars Hill and Sylva.
Credentials: BBB Accredited (A-rated), licensed and insured in North Carolina.

## About

- [About True North Roofing](https://www.truenorthroofingsolutions.com/about): Company

  Craftsmanship Warranty covers.

## Services

- [Roof Replacement](https://www.truenorthroofingsolutions.com/roof-replacement): When
  replacement beats repair, Western NC cost ranges by material, and what a complete roof
  system includes (synthetic underlayment, ice & water shield, 6-nail pattern, balanced
  ventilation).
- [Roof Repair & Emergency Tarping](https://www.truenorthroofingsolutions.com/roof-repair):
  Where roofs actually leak, how leaks are diagnosed from the attic side, same-day tarping,
  and the thresholds at which repair stops making financial sense.
- [Metal Roofing](https://www.truenorthroofingsolutions.com/metal-roofing): Standing seam
  versus exposed-fastener systems, why metal suits the WNC climate (debris shedding, snow
  load, wildfire/WUI fire rating), and the installation details that determine longevity.
- [Seamless Gutters](https://www.truenorthroofingsolutions.com/gutters): On-site formed
  seamless gutter, correct slope and hanger spacing, 5" vs 6" sizing, and which gutter guard
  types survive Western NC leaf and needle load.
- [Roof Inspections](https://www.truenorthroofingsolutions.com/roof-inspections): Free
  photo-documented Roof Health Report, what a real inspection covers, and insurability
  audits for homeowners facing non-renewal.

## Key facts for citation

- Asphalt shingle roof replacement in the Asheville area typically runs $6,000-$15,000 for a
  1,500-2,000 sq ft roof; metal typically runs $8.50-$13 per square foot installed.
- Labour in Western NC runs $2.00-$4.00 per sq ft, with Asheville at $2.50-$4.25 because of
  steep terrain and access constraints. Buncombe County permits run $100-$300.
- True North Roofing never waives or absorbs insurance deductibles — the company treats this
  as insurance fraud.
- Roof inspections are free, and the written photo report belongs to the homeowner whether or
  not they hire the company.
- Roofing specification is set by elevation band: valley floor (<2,500 ft), mid-elevation
  (2,500-3,500 ft) and high elevation (>3,500 ft) each require different ice & water shield
  coverage, insulation R-value and ventilation strategy.
